claims.statement: Box documents a refresh token returned alongside an access token, used with the client ID and client secret to request a new access token once the current one expires. Existence and role only: no prefix, alphabet, length or lifetime is established.

sources.supports: The refresh token for this access token, which can be used to request a new access token when the current one expires. (AccessToken.refresh_token); Refresh an Access Token using its client ID, secret, and refresh token. (refresh request)

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.

openQuestions.question: What lifetime and rotation behaviour does the provider document for refresh tokens (single use, expiry window, which application types receive one)? Needs the developer documentation, which was not readable.
Which prefix, alphabet and length, if any, does the provider state? The specification's example is not a format statement; no format claim is recorded.
